caveats: Gene activity (both methods) summarizes accessibility near a gene; it is not RNA expression. ARIA sums peak accessibility in a window, Signac counts fragments in the gene body + promoter — concordance is rank agreement, not identity.

ARIA's window-sum assigns the SAME score to genes sharing a peak window, so the top-k overlap understates agreement; the genome-wide Spearman over all shared genes is the honest concordance signal (moderate here).

design.aria_method: chromatin_regulatory._gene_scores (peak accessibility summed in a TSS window)
design.feature_space: per-gene mean activity over shared cells
design.reference: Signac::GeneActivity (fragment counts over gene body + promoter)
